title: Marguerite and the Echo
author: S. M. Dunmore
blurb: Lior Crane, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
